sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which is the correct comparative form of the adjective 'beautiful'?
In the poem 'The Swing', what does the child see over the wall?
Identify the adverb in the following sentence: 'The old man walked slowly across the street.'
In the chapter 'The Lagori Champions', how many flat stones are typically used to play the game of Lagori?
Choose the correct preposition of direction: 'The brave cat jumped ___ the high fence.'
In the chapter 'Maheshwar', the beautiful town of Maheshwar is situated on the banks of which river?
Fill in the blank with the correct conjunction of reason: 'She was very tired, ___ she went to bed early.'
According to 'Fit Body Fit Mind Fit Nation', which of the following is a healthy habit?
Choose the correct past tense of the verb 'sing'.
What does the idiom 'piece of cake' mean?

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Why is teamwork so important for the players in 'The Lagori Champions'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Teamwork is essential because players must coordinate closely to rebuild the stone tower quickly while successfully defending themselves from the opposing team's ball hits.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence in the future continuous tense: 'Ravi reads a book in the library.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Ravi will be reading a book in the library. This tense shows that the action of reading will be ongoing at a specific time in the future.

questions.question_text: In the story 'Hekko', what makes the main character special in his forest home? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hekko is a very friendly and magical character. His special ability is talking directly to the wild animals and deeply understanding the hidden secrets of nature.

questions.question_text: Combine these two sentences using the conjunction 'because': 'He missed the school bus. He woke up late.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: He missed the school bus because he woke up late. The conjunction perfectly connects the final result to its exact reason in one smooth sentence.

questions.question_text: How does the child feel while going up in the air in the poem 'The Swing'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The child feels incredibly happy, joyful, and free, considering the upward flight through the bright blue air to be the most pleasant thing a child can do.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are traveling as described in 'A Journey to the Magical Mountains'. Describe the scenery and weather you experience on your way. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: As we travel higher, the weather turns very cold and pleasantly misty. I can see tall snow-capped peaks touching the bright clouds, deep green valleys filled with tall pine trees, and sparkling waterfalls rushing down the rocky slopes, making the journey feel truly magical.

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph comparing a bustling city to a quiet village. You must use at least three adjectives of comparison (e.g., quieter, taller). [40-50 words]
questions.answer: A city is much noisier than a quiet village, with taller buildings blocking the open sky. However, the village is cleaner and much greener than the city. While city life moves faster, village life is definitely more peaceful and much closer to beautiful nature.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to your school librarian requesting them to issue a duplicate library card because you lost your original one. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Librarian, I am writing to respectfully inform you that I accidentally lost my original library card on the school playground yesterday afternoon. I kindly request you to issue a duplicate library card so I can continue borrowing important books for my class assignments. I am ready to pay the required fine. Thank you.

questions.question_text: Based on 'Fit Body Fit Mind Fit Nation', explain how keeping our minds and bodies fit can help in building a strong country. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: When citizens eat healthy food and exercise daily, they build strong bodies and very sharp minds. Fit individuals fall sick less often and work much more efficiently. By staying active, happy, and focused, we become more productive, which directly helps our beautiful country grow stronger, wealthier, and highly successful.
